caption: What if you folded a sheet of paper 103 times? A normal page is about 0.1 mm thick, and every fold doubles it. After 7 folds it is about 1.3 cm. After 17 folds, 13 metres, taller than a 4-storey building. Fold 20 gives 105 metres, taller than Delhi's 72.5 m Qutub Minar. Fold 27 reaches 13 km, above Mount Everest and cruising jets. Fold 41 gets you about halfway to the Moon, and just one more fold, 42, takes you past it. Fold 51 is about 22 crore km, beyond the Sun. Fold 83 stretches roughly 1 lakh light-years, across the whole Milky Way. And fold 103 is wider than the observable universe, about 93 billion light-years. Reality check: each fold needs far more paper than the last, so the famous record is just 12 folds, made with a paper strip about 1.2 km long. How many folds can YOU manage? 👇
